verdict.rationale: Smooth's docs state a clear captcha stance: 'Auto-CAPTCHA solvers' that bypass challenges automatically for uninterrupted execution. A community comment confirms this is part of the public marketing. However, the stance rests on a single intro-page line, with no dedicated feature page explaining coverage or what happens when solving fails. The live-view takeover could serve as a manual fallback, but it is never documented as a captcha-specific fallback path. missing for 10: dedicated captcha documentation (supported captcha types, solve rates), documented failure/error signaling when a solve fails, an explicit human-fallback flow for captchas, independent hands-on corroboration.
